g.text: RTC_PG TO PORz_INPUT OPEN DRAIN BUFFER

text.tspan: Adjust RTC_PG pullup value to minimize the output slew.
Keep the RTC_PG to RTC_PORz PCB trace short to minimize trace capacitance.
Adjust the value of the external pullup resistor when an open-drain output PG is used as
The RTC_PORz input has internal hysteresis and the internal reset could glitch when a slow
The slew rate is recommended to be faster than the limits specified in the LVCMOS IO
buffer electrical specification to minimize possible noise coupling.
The enable pin of the discrete RTC supply (LDO) can be driven by the power-good signal of the
regulator generating the main supply rail (VCC_3V3_MAIN).
In case the regulator does not support a PG signal- output, a resistor pulled up to the LDO supply
input can be used as EN input.
In use cases where TMUX154EDSGR is used, a
glitch can be observed on the output A during
power-up when the EVM is configured for RTC
mode. The analog switch is optional since the
custom board is designed to support a fixed,
PMIC_LPM_SEL is generated based on 5x2 Female gang jumper
By default the MUX SEL pin is high and PMIC_LPM_EN0 drives
pin to turn-OFF the CORE and VDDA to support RTC + IO +DDR
When the MUX SEL pin is low, the PMIC_LPM_EN0 drives the
PMIC enable pin to support "RTC only". In this low power
turned-OFF and the RTC domain is supplied by external
